title: {{NAME}} and the Unicorn's Rainbow Path
moral: When friends work together, they can find the way.
character_anchor: Bright children's book cartoon illustration, bold outlines, vivid flat colours. {{NAME}}, a young boy with brown hair and blue eyes, wearing a sky-blue t-shirt with a rainbow stripe, purple shorts, and white sneakers with rainbow laces — same child, same face, same exact outfit in every image.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} walked through a meadow of soft flowers.
The sky was full of pink and gold clouds.
A white unicorn trotted up to him.
Her mane shimmered with every colour.
"I am lost," she said. "Can you help me?"

pages.content:
{{NAME}} looked at the unicorn closely.
She had big, worried purple eyes.
"I need to find the rainbow path home," she said.
{{NAME}} felt so sorry for her.
"I will help you," he said with a nod.

pages.content:
They walked to the edge of a dark forest.
A huge green dinosaur blocked the path.
He roared and animals scattered away.
The unicorn touched the dinosaur with her horn.
A rainbow burst out into the dark trees.

pages.content:
The rainbow calmed the big dinosaur down.
He blinked and smiled a slow, soft smile.
The rainbow path glowed bright before them.
"That is my way home!" the unicorn cried.
The dinosaur stood aside to let them through.

pages.content:
The unicorn galloped along the rainbow path.
She looked back and waved her shining tail.
The dinosaur sat down beside {{NAME}}.
They watched the rainbow fade into the sky.
{{NAME}} felt warm and happy and very sleepy.
Goodnight, {{NAME}}. Tomorrow the unicorn says she will come back with a surprise for you.
